text:
Alex: Heads-up — scheduling the Tilt Wave gradual rollout tonight at 21:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~40m with 5m observation windows. Exclude enterprise orgs. Need smoke owners per region.
Morgan: I can own NA smoke. Will watch p95 latency, error spikes, and token cost delta.
Priya: I’ll take EU. What metric gates are we using for automatic rollback?
Alex: Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline for 5m. Manual rollback always allowed. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/deploy-rollback (use step 3 for forced rollback).
Sam: Can you paste the cohort selector and the feature flag?
Alex: Cohort filter: `user.bucket <= rollout_pct && user.flags.tilt_wave == true && !user.org.is_enterprise`
Alex: Feature gate: `feature:tilt_wave:v3` — toggles client-side header so we can target based on header + bucket.
Jordan: I’ll validate tracing and synthetic checks 10m before start. Will post smoke checklist after baseline.
Alex: Scheduling notes: deploy job `tilt-wave-deploy` will run in clusters eu/na/ap with staggered kickoff: NA start at 21:00, EU at 21:10, APAC at 21:20.
Morgan: NA checklist: 
- confirm synths green
- tail logs for 10m on svc-infer
- run `kubectl rollout status` for replicas
- validate cost monitor dashboard for token per-request jump
Priya: EU checklist similar, I’ll also watch KV cache hit-rate (we've seen cold-cache regressions before).
Sam: Who’s on call if rollback needs manual approval?
Alex: Oncall rota: Morgan -> Priya -> Jordan. I’m the release owner; I’ll coordinate rollbacks if needed.
Jordan: Posting quick smoke command — use this to hit the new route and inspect headers: 
```bash
curl -H 'X-Feature-Tilt: tilt_wave' -H 'X-Rollout-Bucket: 1' https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/test-smoke
```
Jordan: Also check traces view: tracing.prod?service=tilt-wave (filter by `feature:tilt_wave`)
deploy-bot: [deployment scheduled] tilt-wave-deploy -> queued for 2026-06-04T21:00:00Z by Alex
Alex: Small manual asks: avoid simultaneous heavy batch jobs during ramp window, and don’t merge non-release traffic shaping PRs until after 21:30 UTC.
Morgan: Got it. I’ll mute non-critical alerts for the first 10m of each cohort to reduce noise.
Priya: Noted — I’ll watch cache warming; if hit-rate < 70% after first 10m we pause ramp and investigate.
Sam: I'll do a quick CR review of the config change now — should be done in 15m.
Alex: Thanks — after CR and Jordan's trace baseline, I’ll flip the schedule to active. Post any concerns here. :thumbsup:
Morgan: One more — confirm fallback model variant IDs for degraded mode?
Alex: Fallbacks: model-bert-quantv2 and model-llm-small-fallback; routing policy will shift to fallback if error-rate crosses threshold.
Jordan: I’ll post the smoke result summary once NA baseline is collected (~20m before start).
Priya: Ready on EU side, I’ll be watching KV metrics and errors.
Sam: CR done, lgtm.
Alex: OK launching as planned. If anyone needs to trigger manual rollback, ping me + call the pager.
Morgan: Copy, standing by. :eyes:
